title: Projects
intro: This page presents a collection of my projects, spanning web design, React development, and object-oriented programming. Each project highlights different skills and stages of my learning journey, demonstrating experimentation, growth, and practical application. Together, they reflect the evolution of my abilities.

codigodesconocido.name: Código Desconocido
codigodesconocido.description: Escape room management platform with a web panel, backend, and Dockerized chat. Supports bookings and interaction for educational and entertainment use.

vehicle.name: Vehicle Fleet Management
vehicle.description: EV fleet system developed at UNED. Manages users, rates, and maintenance using OOP principles like inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation.

design.name: DAW Projects
design.description: Web development projects ranging from HTML/CSS/JS design to full Laravel applications with AJAX, showing my progression in modern web building.

reactlogo.name: React Practice Projects
reactlogo.description: Interactive apps focused on component-driven development, state management, and responsive UI, showcasing my hands-on experience with the React ecosystem.
